name: Let your team schedule social posts from a web form with Socialync

parameters.content:
### How it works
This workflow gives your team a simple web form for posting. Someone writes a caption, ticks the platforms, adds a picture and picks a time. The workflow uploads the picture to Socialync and schedules the post. A person who leaves the time empty gets a post ten minutes later, which leaves time to cancel it in Socialync. The form asks for a user name and password, because anyone who can open it can post to your accounts.

Posts are scheduled without a manual approval step. You can cancel or change any scheduled post in Socialync until it goes out.

### Setup
1. Create an API key at https://socialync.io/go/n8n-node-keys and add it as a Socialync credential.
2. Create a Basic Auth credential with a user name and password for the form, and pick it on the form node.
3. In Settings, choose the time zone and the platforms people may pick.
4. Activate the workflow and open the production form address. Test with a short caption.

### Customization
The form lists the platforms you put in its checkbox field. Add or remove choices there and in Settings together. A picture is optional. TikTok and YouTube need a video, so this form leaves them out.

API reference: https://socialync.io/go/n8n-node

parameters.formDescription: Write the post, choose where it goes and when. Leave the time empty to post in about ten minutes.

options.formSubmittedText: Thanks. Your post is being scheduled.

nodes.name: Build the post from the form

parameters.content:
## Take the form
Someone submits the form. Settings holds the time zone and the delay.

## Add the picture
A picture is uploaded to Socialync first, which gives a media ID.

## Schedule it
Socialync schedules the post. The form answer says it is being scheduled.

## Protect the form
Pick the Basic Auth credential on the form node before you activate this workflow.
